official.deadline_note: For the 2026/27 cycle the same date applied to semester/partial studies, full degree studies and short or long-term study visits, while summer courses closed on 27 February 2026 at 5 pm CET. Applicants going through their national scholarship office must also meet that office's own, earlier deadline. Dates for the next cycle are not yet published.
official.application_cycle: 2026/27 academic year (calls published for the academic year 2026-2027)
official.status_note: The published calls for the 2026/2027 academic year closed on 19 February 2026 (27 February 2026 for summer courses). The bilateral state scholarships page is live and describes the two application routes, but no dates for the following cycle have been posted yet.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The tuition fee is covered by the Hungarian state. Accepted applicants are entitled to participate in courses free of charge.
benefits: Tuition fee covered by the Hungarian state; accepted applicants participate in courses free of charge
A monthly stipend paid by the receiving higher education institution
The stipend may be completed by a supplement, an accommodation contribution etc. depending on the type of scholarship
Healthcare cover in medical necessity during the stay in Hungary
Dormitory accommodation subject to the capacity of the university
eligibility: Applications may be submitted by citizens of the countries listed in and depending on the specific conditions of the Calls for application
Applicants must be over 18 years of age by 1 September 2026; there is no upper age limit

Applicants must not be foreign citizens with permanent residence in Hungary, foreign citizens employed as defined by the Hungarian Labour Law, or foreign citizens residing or living in Hungary (except those pursuing full degree studies with a Hungarian State scholarship who wish to continue at a higher level)
Applicants must not have already started the studies they wish to apply for at a Hungarian higher education institution
Applicants who did not meet their obligation to submit the final report for previous Bilateral State Scholarships are not eligible
Applicants in receipt of another Hungarian-state or EU scholarship for the same purpose or time period are not eligible and must choose between them
requirements: Applications must be submitted into the Tempus Public Foundation online system (scholarship.hu) in both the country-nomination and individual routes
Only complete applications submitted before the deadline through the online system are accepted; applications by post or e-mail will not be accepted
Applicants applying under the bilateral agreement system must also submit their application and required documents to the organisation responsible for scholarships in the sending country
At most one application can be submitted; if several are submitted, the last one is considered valid
A maximum of two applications can be granted provided they do not overlap in time and budgetary allocations allow
Scholarship-holders must stay in Hungary for the entire period of their studies, excluding school and public holidays and justified vis maior cases with prior consent
Scholarship-holders must submit an online professional report within 30 days after finishing the scholarship period
documents: Application form of Tempus Public Foundation, downloaded from the online system, signed and dated by hand with a scanned version uploaded

Proof of language proficiency required for the programme (at least B2 knowledge), for example a language exam certificate or a certificate issued by the sending institution, foreign Hungarian Cultural Institute, lectorate or consul, in Hungarian or English
Copy of the highest degree or certificate

For bachelor, master and one-tier master studies: a motivation letter of minimum 1 and maximum 2 pages following the published template, and a Preliminary Acceptance Letter issued by the relevant head of department and international office of a Hungarian higher education institution, dated, stamped and signed on institutional letterhead with contact details

For full doctoral studies: a precise and detailed work plan of minimum 1 and maximum 5 pages, a publication list, a Preliminary Acceptance Letter issued by the head of the accredited doctoral school, and two Letters of Recommendation from two recognised experts in the relevant discipline with original signature, date and institutional letterhead (recommendations older than 6 months cannot be accepted, and the signers cannot be the same as those of the Letter of Invitation)
For art scholarships: documentation of 5 works of art with dates of creation or a link to the works (fine and applied artists), or links to 3 performances of different styles (performing artists)
selection_criteria: Applications are assessed by the Hungarian side: first a formal eligibility check, then Tempus Public Foundation's external experts score the applications along several professional criteria
Applications nominated and ranked by partner offices are evaluated together with individually submitted applications
Decisions are made by the Board of Trustees of Tempus Public Foundation in the name of the Minister responsible for higher education in Hungary
Any kind of undue influence on the evaluation or the application procedure causes immediate exclusion from the selection procedure
coverage: Tuition fee is covered by the Hungarian state
Stipend for bachelor and master studies: 56,600 HUF per month, expressly not covering the cost of living
Stipend for doctoral studies: 140,000 HUF per month in the 1st and 2nd year and 180,000 HUF per month in the 3rd and 4th year, not necessarily covering the cost of living
Accommodation in a student dormitory depending on the capacity of the university, paid by the scholarship-holder
Travel expenses to Hungary, within Hungary and back to the country of origin are not covered by Tempus Public Foundation
No financial support is provided for visa fees or any allowance for accompanying persons

Scholarship-holders nominated by their sending relation from Poland (and, for partial studies, the Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic) receive their stipend from the sending relation, so the amount is set by that country's scholarship office
application_method: Route 1 (country nomination): submit the application to your own country's national scholarship office, which assesses it and prepares a nomination list, and also submit an application into the Tempus Public Foundation online system
Route 2 (individual application): submit the application directly into the Tempus Public Foundation online system
Register online with a user ID and password, fill in the CV and attach the application documents under Documents to be submitted
The application is assessed by a formal eligibility check and then scored by Tempus Public Foundation external experts

Applicants, and in the country-nomination case the national offices, are informed of the decision by email; successful applicants also receive the information needed to organise and start their stay in Hungary
official.application_route: Either be nominated by your home country's national scholarship office or apply individually, and in both cases submit the application into the Tempus Public Foundation online system at scholarship.hu before the closing date.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to foreign nationals who are citizens of the countries covered by the relevant bilateral cooperation agreement. Foreign citizens with permanent residence in Hungary, those employed under Hungarian labour law and those residing or living in Hungary are not eligible, with a narrow exception for those continuing to a higher level on a Hungarian State scholarship.
official.international_eligibility: Open to foreign nationals from partner countries under bilateral cooperation agreements between Hungary and the applicant's country.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The scholarship is available for studies at any accredited Hungarian higher education institution listed in Annex 12 to Act CCIV of 2011 on National Higher Education, in any field of arts or sciences. If the language of instruction is not Hungarian, students must attend courses of Hungarian language and culture.
official.research_requirement: For full doctoral studies, a precise and detailed work plan of 1 to 5 pages and a publication list are required, along with a Preliminary Acceptance Letter from the head of the accredited doctoral school.
official.duration: Semester or partial studies 3-10 months; full degree studies 36 months for bachelor, 24 months for master and 36 months for doctoral programmes; short or long-term study visits 3 days to 6 months; summer courses 2-4 weeks. Full academic year runs September to June.
official.description: Bilateral state scholarships are based on scientific and educational cooperation agreements signed by the governments of two countries, with the Hungarian side offering scholarships for foreign students, researchers or lecturers in higher education institutions or in scientific or art institutions. Tempus Public Foundation, a background organisation of the Hungarian Ministry of Culture and Innovation, is Hungary's national scholarship office and administers the scheme.
official.english_requirement: Proof of language proficiency required for the programme, at least B2 knowledge, for example a language exam certificate or a certificate issued by the sending institution, foreign Hungarian Cultural Institute, lectorate or consul, written in Hungarian or English. Where the language of instruction is not Hungarian, students must attend courses of Hungarian language and culture.

applicant_utility.summary: Decide early which of the two routes you are on, because they are not interchangeable in practice: country nominees must satisfy their own national scholarship office's earlier deadline before Tempus's 19 February date, while individual applicants only face the Tempus system. The money is a monthly stipend - 56,600 HUF for master's and 140,000 to 180,000 HUF for doctoral study - and the call itself says it does not cover the cost of living, with dormitory accommodation, travel to and within Hungary and visa fees all outside the award. Tuition, by contrast, is covered by the Hungarian state, which is where the real value sits.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Nationals of a country with a bilateral cooperation agreement with Hungary who already have, or can quickly obtain, a Preliminary Acceptance Letter from a Hungarian host institution.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country appears in the eligible countries and scholarship types list for the current cycle before doing anything else
Contact your national scholarship office as early as possible if you are going the nomination route, since it sets its own deadline and ranks candidates before Tempus ever sees the file

Secure the Preliminary Acceptance Letter on institutional letterhead, dated, stamped and signed by the head of department and international office - this is the single item applicants most often leave too late
Prepare translations into Hungarian or English for any document not already in Hungarian, English, French or German
Book a B2-level language certificate early and keep it verifiable, since the call names B2 as the minimum
If you hold an existing Hungarian-state or EU scholarship for the same period, resolve the choice before applying - you may only use one
common_rejection_risks: Incomplete applications: only complete applications submitted before the deadline through the online system are accepted, and postal or emailed applications are refused outright
A Preliminary Acceptance Letter that is unsigned, undated or missing institutional contact details
Submitting more than one application without realising only the last one counts, or being awarded two overlapping scholarships
Failing to also submit into the Tempus system after being nominated by the home country
Falling into an excluded category: permanent residence in Hungary, employment under Hungarian labour law, or already having started the studies you are applying for
Owing a final report from a previous Bilateral State Scholarship, which blocks eligibility outright
Any perceived attempt to influence the evaluation, which causes immediate exclusion
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The stipend is explicitly stated not to cover the cost of living, and dormitory accommodation is paid by the scholarship-holder, as are travel to Hungary, travel within Hungary, travel home, visa fees and any support for accompanying persons.
document_audit: The application form must be downloaded from the online system, signed and dated by hand, then scanned and uploaded - a typed signature is a rejection risk

Letters of Recommendation for doctoral applicants must be no more than 6 months old, carry original signatures and be on institutional letterhead, and their signers may not be the same people who signed the Letter of Invitation
The motivation letter has a strict 1 to 2 page limit and must follow the published template
For art scholarships, portfolios must either list dates of creation for 5 works or provide links to 3 performances of different styles
Documents issued outside the four accepted languages need official Hungarian or English translations attached alongside the original
alerts: Decisions are notified by email only, so a monitored inbox is essential; objections may be sent to bilateral@tpf.hu within 30 days of the notification date
The scholarship must start in the autumn semester of the period stated in the call and cannot be postponed to the following academic year
Scholarship-holders must remain in Hungary for the whole study period, with at most a 30-day uninterrupted period abroad during full degree studies
A mobility report is due within 30 days of finishing, and failing to submit it excludes you from future scholarships
Every publication or thesis arising from the scholarship must acknowledge support from the Hungarian Government
The 2026/27 round closed on 19 February 2026, so the next cycle's dates need watching on the Tempus page
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: National office nomination or individual application, then submission into scholarship.hu before the closing date, then formal eligibility check, external expert scoring, and an email decision from the Board of Trustees with results and arrival information issued in May-June.
